description: This file defines the CParser class, which provides functionality to parse PDF content streams within the PDFsharp library. It includes multiple constructors for different input types, parsing logic for PDF content tokens, and methods to create and process PDF operators and objects.

classes.name: CParser
classes.description: A class for parsing PDF content streams, handling tokens, and constructing PDF content objects and operators.

methods.name: CParser
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the parser with different input types (PdfPage, byte array, MemoryStream, CLexer).

methods.name: ReadContent
methods.description: Reads and parses the entire content stream into a CSequence object.

methods.name: ParseObject
methods.description: Parses tokens until a stop symbol is reached, constructing PDF objects and operators.

methods.name: CreateOperator
methods.description: Creates a COperator object based on the current token or specified operator name.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Advances the lexer to the next token and returns its symbol.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Advances the lexer to the next token, outputs the token string, and returns its symbol.

methods.name: ReadSymbol
methods.description: Reads the next token and verifies it matches the expected symbol.
